Merge multi-tile GLASS rasters

Source: R/read_process.R
glass_mosaic.Rd

Tile-aware convenience wrapper over terra::merge(): merges the extent of several tiled granules (from the same sinusoidal source grid) into a single raster.

Usage

glass_mosaic(...)

Arguments

...

SpatRaster objects (each the result of glass_read()).

Value

A merged SpatRaster.
